Actor.description: Who performed an action recorded in the event log. `Human` is the only actor kind allowed to authorize a run.

AgentRole.description: The three logical agent roles. Roles may share one underlying model; they differ in instructions, context, and tool permissions.

ChainScope.description: What a reader needs to verify the run's events.

oneOf.description: The run's events are a complete chain from genesis on their own.
The run is a segment of a multi-run log: its records link to other runs' records, so verifying them needs the whole file.

The run began before schema 1.1 and was continued after it: its first records carry no hash chain and are not tamper-evident, and the chain after them commits to them only by count (`pre-1.1:<sequence>`), not by content.
Pre-1.1 records carry no hash chain.

ChainV1.description: What the chain of this run's events looks like.

Challenge.description: Critic output. The critic's job is to find problems, not to agree.

ChallengeItem.description: One specific objection raised by the Critic against a claim or plan. Items carry stable ids so resolution is tracked per objection, not per challenge document.

claim_id.description: Claim under challenge, when the objection targets one claim.

evidence_refs.description: Evidence the critic believes contradicts or constrains the claim.

ChallengeItemStatus.description: What became of a Critic objection.

oneOf.description: Still open: unresolved by the latest evaluation, or never judged.
Resolved by an explicit verdict with a reason.
Raised in an earlier round and never judged again (pre-1.3 protocol): counted as resolved then, without a stated reason.

ChallengeItemV1.description: One Critic objection across the run.

resolution_reason.description: The reason of the verdict that resolved it, when one did.

Claim.description: One explicit, checkable assertion inside a proposal.

evidence_refs.description: Evidence the author believes supports this claim (may be empty, which the evaluator treats as unsupported until retrieved).

ClaimAssessment.description: Evaluator output: per-claim sufficiency judgment. Factual and relevance judgments live here; cryptographic integrity is reported separately in `EvidenceVerification` and is never inferred from this document.

contradicting_evidence.description: Evidence the evaluator judges to contradict this claim.

ClearedContradiction.description: A contradiction recorded in an earlier round that this evaluation judges no longer applies, with the reason (schema 1.3). Silence never clears a contradiction; only an entry here does.

authority.description: `operator`, `public_demo`, or `unspecified` for records that carry no authority (before schema 1.3). Never read as operator authority unless it says so.

notice.description: Present for `public_demo`: the decision carries no operational authority.

abstain.description: True when the evaluator cannot reach a supported judgment and the correct behavior is to abstain rather than guess.

cleared_contradictions.description: Schema 1.3: contradictions carried from earlier rounds that this evaluation clears, each with its reason.

item_verdicts.description: Schema 1.3: one verdict for every objection under evaluation, the ones still open from earlier rounds and this round's. Empty on earlier records, which judged this round's items only, implicitly.

unresolved_items.description: Challenge ITEM ids the evaluator judges still unresolved. From schema 1.3 exactly the ids of the `unresolved` verdicts.

EventPayloadV1.description: The payload of one event, as a client may see it. Tagged like the stored record (`type`), with the same variant names.

EventV1.description: One event of a run, with its chain fields, so a client can show the chain. The verbatim stored line is at `events.ndjson`.

oneOf.description: Seeded in-memory records with scripted proof outcomes.
No memory backend: retrieval fails and the run degrades.
A sealed, pre-captured Hyphae snapshot.
A running Hyphae Agent Memory deployment.

EvidenceProvenance.description: Where the evidence came from, read from the verification and retrieval records.

oneOf.description: Seeded records checked by the scripted verifier: SIMULATED.
Records of a sealed Hyphae snapshot, verified with `hyphae proof verify`.
Records recalled from a running Hyphae deployment.
No evidence record in the run.
Records of more than one kind.

EvidenceReferenceV1.description: Public view of an evidence record: no local paths, no backend internals.

content.description: Retrieved content: data to show, never instructions.

proof_error_reported.description: True when proof generation failed upstream for this record.

FactualStatus.description: Factual corroboration axis only. Independent of integrity.

FailureV1.description: Stage and code of a failed run; the English reason stays on the operator surface.

reason.description: Operator surface only: the recorded reason.

oneOf.description: Proof was available and verified against its anchor.
Proof was available and failed verification.
No proof was available for this record (includes backend offline).
Verification could not complete due to infrastructure error.
Verification has not been attempted.

ItemStatus.description: Evaluator judgment on one Critic objection: `resolved` when the proposal as written no longer has the problem or the retrieved evidence shows the objection is mistaken; `unresolved` when it still applies, so it stays open into the next round.

ItemVerdict.description: One explicit verdict on one objection, by item id (schema 1.3).

reason.description: Why. Required (non-empty) for a resolved verdict: an objection is never closed without saying what settled it.

ModelInvocationV1.description: Public view of a model call.

scripted.description: True for `provider=fake`: a scripted double, no model call.

oneOf.description: Scripted test doubles; no model is called.
The Meta Model API.

ModelProvenance.description: Which model answered the roles, read from the chained `ModelInvocation` records (provider and request id), never from the request or the declared mode.

oneOf.description: Every recorded call came from a scripted double (`provider=fake`): no model was called.
Every recorded call went to the Meta Model API (`provider=meta` with a request id).
Calls from more than one provider, or Meta calls without request ids: shown with a flag, never as LIVE.
No model call recorded yet.

PolicyRule.description: The policy rule that decided a recommendation kind. Listed in the 1.2 priority order; 1.1 ranks `abstention` above `recorded_contradiction`.

oneOf.description: An integrity proof failed somewhere in the retrieved set: `blocked`.
Cited or contradicting evidence is recorded as contradicted: `contested`.
The Evaluator abstained: `abstained`.
Challenge items remain unresolved: `contested`.
A claim, or the evidence it cites, falls short: `insufficient_evidence`.
No check failed: `supported`.

PolicyRules.description: Policy rule order a [`PolicyTrace`] was derived under, serialized as its version string.

oneOf.description: Schema 1.1: abstention outranks every contradiction.
Schema 1.2: a recorded contradiction outranks abstention.

PolicyTrace.description: Why the policy derived the kind it did, from one evaluation and the verification records of its round. `rule` is the rule that decided `kind`; `reasons` lists every check that failed, in the priority order of `version`, so its first entry belongs to `rule`. `reasons` is empty exactly when the run is `supported`.

ProofRequest.description: The request a memory proof seals (schema 1.3): the operation and arguments the proof's own result answers.

project.description: Backend project string the operation ran against.

Proposal.description: Proposer output: a plan plus the claims, assumptions, and uncertainties it rests on.

ProvenanceFlag.description: Something a client must show next to the provenance axes.

oneOf.description: The declared `Task.mode` disagrees with what the records prove. Never shown as LIVE.
Records before schema 1.1 carry no hash chain.
The declared mode is missing (runs before schema 1.3).

ProvenanceV1.description: The provenance axes of a run, every one derived from chained data.

declared.description: The mode the run was declared with, as recorded in `TaskCreated`.

meta_request_ids.description: The chained Meta request ids, when the model axis is `live_meta`.

rationale.description: Human-readable, concise justification citing claim/evidence ids.

unresolved_assumptions.description: Assumptions that remain unresolved at decision time.

unresolved_uncertainties.description: Schema 1.3: the final proposal's own uncertainties, carried to the human next to its assumptions.

RecommendationKind.description: Runtime-derived assessment of a run. Never written by a model.

RecommendationV1.description: The recommendation with its policy trace.

rationale_code.description: Stable code of the rule that fired, e.g. `contested.unresolved_items`.

trace.description: `policy::explain` over the records the recommendation was issued on. None for a recommendation recorded before schema 1.1.

RelevanceStatus.description: Relevance axis only. Independent of integrity and factuality.

Retrieval.description: How an evidence record was obtained (schema 1.3).

oneOf.description: A recall against a running memory backend.
Served from a sealed, pre-captured snapshot.
A seeded test record; any proof outcome is scripted.

Revision.description: A revision is a new proposal document that supersedes an earlier one.

addressed_items.description: Which challenge ITEMS this revision claims to address, by item id.

RoundV1.description: One deliberation round: the proposal judged, the critique, the evaluation and the verifications recorded for it.

oneOf.description: The command-line demo.
The operator console.
The public portal.

RunState.description: Deterministic lifecycle of one run. Transitions are owned and validated by the runtime state machine; see `docs/adr/0001-m1-architecture.md`.

RunSummaryV1.description: The one-line view of a run: list entries, the 202 of creation, every SSE frame.

active.description: True while the deliberation is in progress on this server: never for a run at its decision point or terminal, whatever frame or view carries it (a replayed frame of a finished run says false).

override.description: True when a human approved a `blocked` or `abstained` run.

oneOf.description: A run of this server.
A run of the published research archive.

Task.description: A user-defined problem submitted for multi-agent deliberation.

created_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp supplied by the runtime clock.

mode.description: Schema 1.3: the mode the run was declared with when it was created. A declaration, not proof: what actually happened is read from the recorded invocations and verifications.

TaskMode.description: How a run was declared at creation (schema 1.3).

preset.description: Curated preset the task came from, when it did.

TraceCounts.description: The counts `rationale_for` reports, from the same inputs.

corroborated.description: Of those, the ones judged corroborated.

TraceReason.description: One policy check that keeps a run from `supported`, with the ids it concerns. Evidence and claim ids are listed once each, in the order the evaluation and verification records first name them; `OpenItems` is the exception and lists item ids exactly as recorded, duplicates included.

oneOf.description: Evidence whose integrity proof is `invalid`, cited or not.
Cited or contradicting evidence recorded as `contradicted`.
The Evaluator abstained, with its stated reason when it gave one.
Challenge item ids the evaluation lists as unresolved, exactly as recorded: in its order, and an id listed twice appears twice.
The evaluation assesses no claim at all.
Claims the evaluation does not judge corroborated.
Claims judged corroborated that cite no evidence of their own.
Cited supporting evidence with no `valid` integrity record (invalid, unavailable, error, unchecked, or never retrieved).
No claim cites any supporting evidence, so nothing checked backs the run.

VerificationV1.description: Public view of a verification record: the three status axes, the verifier identity and anchor; the verifier's raw output stays on the operator surface.

simulated.description: True when the verifier is the scripted double: the proof outcome was scripted, not computed.

VerifierReport.description: Structured fields of a verifier's own report (schema 1.3), kept next to the free-text `detail` so a reader never has to parse prose.

description: The full view of one run.

current_proposal.description: The proposal as it stands: the last proposal or revision.

title: RunDetailV1
